$comment: Entities the dialogues talk to or change, for the map designer. Ids are fixed: dialogues reference them (setEntity/setController/startCombat). 'dialogue' is the tree to tag on the entity (dialogue:<id>); null when a script opens it or it only appears as a speaker. noncombatant: tag it until a dialogue starts a fight. essential: the story needs it alive. 'commoner' means a plain non-fighter. spriteId exists in assets/0x72.json. Generic creatures are not here: the maps spawn them as <template>-<n> from templates.json (dialogues use those spawn ids, e.g. fanatico_pala-1). Interactables are spawns <kind>-<x> with dialogue <kind>_<x>. Party members hero and dorotea are created by game.ts.

dorotea.name: Dorotea
dorotea.note: In the party from the start (game.ts creates her: rogue, human). Her dialogue is the companion chat "dorotea". In D4 she can leave (faction valcarcel) or fight the party.

garran.name: Garrán
garran.note: Companion. Create him like game.ts does (createCharacter fighter, half_orc, level 3) but controllerId "ai", faction "neutral", tags noncombatant. Recruiting switches him to player:1/party and his dialogue to "garran".

minero_cabecilla.name: Cabecilla de los mineros
minero_cabecilla.note: Blocks the road with the other three. Tutorial fight if talks fail.

anselmo.name: Fray Anselmo
anselmo.note: Companion, on the gallows platform of the Torre del Cepo. Create him like game.ts does (createCharacter cleric, halfling, level 3) but controllerId "ai", faction "neutral", tags noncombatant. Every outcome of the trial recruits him and switches his dialogue to "anselmo".

cirilo.name: Cirilo Hondo
cirilo.note: Chaplain of the Santa Pala. In the square for the trial (same tree as Anselmo); afterwards his dialogue becomes "cirilo". In scene 3 he is at the chapel of the Santa Pala.

nella.name: Nella Yesca
nella.note: Leader of the Cuadrilla, in the square. Later scenes (D1) will give her more dialogue.

odda.name: Odda Hulla
odda.note: Dwarf, Nella's right hand. Fights in D1 depending on the choice.

odda_noche.name: Odda Hulla
odda_noche.note: Odda at the abbey gate on the night of the torches (D1, defend: d1_abadia). Same character as odda; a separate id because entity ids are unique per world. Added by the map agent; the writer may refine it.

mazo.name: Barón Ulric Mazo
mazo.note: In the chapter house. The audience (audiencia_abadia) is opened by script when the party enters; later scenes (D1, D4) will give him more.

hilda.name: Hilda Cardo
hilda.note: Seneschal, behind the baron during the audience; talkable in the abbey afterwards.

benita.name: Benita
benita.note: Named widow washing clothes at the river Lloro (calles: rename spawn viuda-1 to benita).

casilda.name: Casilda
casilda.note: Ivo's widow, Garrán's sister-in-law (calles: rename spawn viuda-2 to casilda).

guardia_abadia.name: Guardia de la abadía
guardia_abadia.note: Named guard at the abbey gate in the plaza (rename spawn guardia_baron-1 to guardia_abadia). Lets the party in once juicio_resuelto is set: audiencia_concedida + travel to abadia/entry-plaza.

absalon.name: Absalón Brea
absalon.note: The boss. The Vault scene zone opens boveda_brea (speaker absalon); he fights with the Callados (faction callados).

ivo.name: Ivo
ivo.note: Garrán's half-brother, a Callado at Brea's side. Speaks in boveda_brea and boveda_collera.
